title: Products of pro-étale module sheaves are exact
statement:
Let $\mathcal R$ be a sheaf of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$. For every set $I$ and every
family of short exact sequences $0\to A_i\to B_i\to C_i\to0$ of $\mathcal R$-modules,
the sequence $0\to\prod_iA_i\to\prod_iB_i\to\prod_iC_i\to0$ is exact. Equivalently, the
functor $\prod_{i\in I}\colon\Mod(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal R)^I\to
\Mod(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal R)$ is exact.

proof.text: Fix an affine weakly contractible object $W$. By [det-pe-sections-limits-colimits], evaluation at $W$ commutes with products, so the evaluation of the product sequence is the product over $i$ of the exact sequences $0	o A_i(W)	o B_i(W)	o C_i(W)	o0$ supplied by [det-pe-wc-sections-exact]. The product sequence of modules is exact coordinatewise: injectivity and the kernel equality are checked coordinate by coordinate, and for any tuple $(c_i)_{i\in I}$ choose, for each $i$, a preimage $b_i\in B_i(W)$; then $(b_i)_i$ maps to $(c_i)_i$.

source.place: paragraph beginning “Products of sheaves are computed sectionwise”

proof.text: The evaluated product sequence is therefore exact for every affine weakly contractible $W$. Apply [det-pe-sections-conservative], clause 1, to obtain exactness at the middle sheaf. Applying the same criterion to the sequences $0	o\prod_i A_i	o\prod_i B_i$ and $\prod_i B_i	o\prod_i C_i	o0$ gives injectivity of the first map and surjectivity of the second (the zero terms evaluate to zero), so $0	o\prod_iA_i	o\prod_iB_i	o\prod_iC_i	o0$ is exact. This is precisely exactness of the product functor.

source.place: paragraph ending “the product sequence of sheaves is exact”
